name: fullstack
title: Full stack Node + React
description: One Fastify server serves the API under /api and the built React client (Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Vitest).
conventions: API routes live under /api in server/features/<feature> and are registered in server/routes/index.ts.
Client code lives in client/src/features/<feature>. Import from client/src with the @/ alias.
Server tests call app.inject. Client tests start with the comment // @vitest-environment jsdom.
Server code imports local files with the .ts extension and uses only erasable TypeScript.
